item.content:encoded:
Activity scans of the brain show many hosts, at this stage, have gone insane.

The word "insane" has no medical or scientific meaning and could not be less clinical in this context. What exactly is wrong with their brain?

CAT scans of the host's brain activity show panic and fear as the only dominant thoughts

Is neither clinical nor accurate. CAT scans do not "show thoughts". CAT scans aren't even used for functional ("activity") neuroimaging. A PET scan might show high activity in the amygdala and other brain regions associated with panic and fear, but that is not the same as showing the patient's "dominant thoughts".

Verdict: Downvote for bad science

Recommendation: Read up on neurology.
